verdict.rationale: The AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D is a desktop CPU, and an official CLI for AI-native or agentic workflows is not something buyers compare CPUs on. The only first-party software in the evidence is the Ryzen Master tuning and monitoring utility, which is a graphical overclocking tool, not a CLI. Nothing in the pack shows the product ships a CLI, so the axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
